name: Pale Glow
description: Raise a faint silver glow in the palm to light a dim place and show what hides in it.

name: Silver Tug
description: Draw a foe's weapon hand off its line with a gentle unseen tug at range.

name: Lunar Push
description: Press a silver breath of qi against a foe's chest to push the foe back a pace.

name: Moonlit Screen
description: Spread a thin sheet of pale light before the user to dim and slow a thrown missile.

name: Halo Step
description: Skip across the ground in a short silvery bound with the body's weight lessened.

name: Draw Hand
description: Open the hand and pull a foe's raised weapon a finger's breadth off its line.

name: Push Palm
description: Thrust a palm and send an unseen push into a foe's ribs from arm's reach.

name: Ebb Tug
description: Draw a slow ebbing pull on a foe's stance so each step takes more effort.

name: Flow Push
description: Push an incoming missile aside with a flowing wave of qi.

name: Lunar Weigh
description: Judge by its pull on the user's qi how heavy a thing is without touching it.

name: Level Pull
description: Pull the user's own body toward a distant mark in one smooth glide.

name: Silver Mirror
description: Hold up a disc of polished qi that turns a glancing blow aside with a flash.

name: Mirror Glint
description: Flash reflected light into a foe's eyes to blur the next strike.

name: Reflect Shot
description: Gather a spark of light and cast it back at the source of a gleam.

name: Mirror Reading
description: Study a reflection in the disc to see what stands behind the user.

name: Glint Lure
description: Hold a bright glint at a distance so a foe's eyes drift from the user.

name: Dim Veil
description: Lower the user's own glow to a dull haze so a foe's aim slips.

name: Silver Ripple
description: Spread a ring of pale ripples that jolts every foe at close range.

name: Slow Tide
description: Let a slow tide of pull settle on a foe's limbs until they feel heavy.

name: Rising Wave
description: Raise a short wave of qi that rolls across the ground and knocks feet from under.

name: Falling Ebb
description: Draw the force out of a foe's charge as the tide leaves the sand.

name: Tide Mark
description: Mark a point in the field and feel when anything crosses its pull.

name: Tidal Brace
description: Set the stance against a rush and let the pull of the ground hold it.

name: Waxing Hand
description: Rest a hand on an ally and wake a little of the strength that sleeps there.

name: Waking Touch
description: Press a thumb to an ally's wrist and rouse the dormant qi there.

name: Growing Pulse
description: Nurse a spark of unused talent in an ally by feeding it a steady pulse.

name: Bright Edge
description: Bring the waxing light to the edge of the hand and cut across a foe's guard.

name: Crescent Arc
description: Throw a thin curved blade of light a short way.

name: Lit Stride
description: Lay a strip of silver light on the ground and glide along it.

name: Hidden Draw
description: Draw a hidden thing toward the surface of notice so the user sees it.

name: Latent Stir
description: Stir the latent power in a dormant tool and make it hum.

name: Shy Gleam
description: Catch the gleam of a concealed object that ordinary light would miss.

name: Unseen Nudge
description: Nudge a foe's balance at range with a faint push the foe does not see.

name: Phase Guard
description: Shift the guard through slow phases from thin to thick as a blow nears.
